summary.text: Steven Schroer is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota State Senate, District 57, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Zach Duckworth (R).
A nonprofit professional, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he moved to Lakeville after his family lost their home in the Great Recession.

paragraphs.text: Steven Schroer graduated from Lakeville North High School, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as nonprofit professional.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he interned with Sen. Lindsey Port, chair of the housing committee, and that in 2024 he was a lead organizer in unionizing his workplace.
Ballotpedia also lists Schroer as a candidate for Minnesota House District 57B who did not appear on the August 11 primary ballot.
In the survey, he described a "Minnesota Plan" of proportional representation including ranked-choice voting, campaign finance reform and mandatory retirement ages for politicians.
He also listed more housing, universal health care, and bringing child care into the public school system among his priorities.
